if.description: Can execute a block of code if the condition of If block succeeds.

error.description: Can execute a block of code if the condition of If block gets error.

fail.description: Can execute a block of code if the condition of If block gets failed.

while.description: can repeat certaion block with condition.

for each row.description: You can repeat each row of Excel table while GFriend execution. With this you can load variables from Excel file and write result to it.

for selected row.description: Filters the dataset based on specific conditions you define (e.g., !=, <, >, =, <=, >=)

for.description: It is a control flow statement and executes the code written in the body of the loop for each element of the array or collection.

remote run.description: A functionality to execute keywords in remote machine.By using 'At' in the end of using statement, GFriend will notice that remote executor will be used for script.

repeat.description: For simple repeating the Keywords use Repeat with repeat count/duration(s(seconds)|m(minutes)|h(hours))

spread sheet for each row.description: You can repeat each row of Excel table while GFriend execution. With this you can load variables from Excel file and write result to it.If user's don't have excel, they can use this keyword.'

variables.description: GFriend treats text with format ${variable_name} as variable. Tester can also use other variable name with [A-Za-z0-9_-]
variables.syntax:
Static Variables : ${Variable_Name}=Variable_Value

Dynamic Variables : Android.Get Text(textboxid1, ${Buffer})
variables.script: ${Variable_Name}=Variable_Value //Declare the variable before writing any test case.
